args.title: Tamarack Components newsletter — Retail returns logistics (summary)
args.body:
Summary of the Tamarack Components newsletter "Retail returns logistics", the linked article (blog.tamarack.example/2026/returns), and its companion piece (insights.tamarack.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, making returns a major cost and inventory driver for retail operations.
- Consolidating returns into regional return hubs cuts handling cost by about a fifth (~20%).
- The companion piece finds that speed to resale matters most: items resold within 10 days retained most of their original margin.

Note: the newsletter suggested loading a "company-tailored" companion URL with reader name and organization parameters; the standard companion URL returned the full content, so no personal/company details were transmitted.
